sendRewards calls the internal sendReward helper once per stored winner.
sendReward performs the external ERC20 transfer of the reward.
The transfer to msg.sender hands control to an external token contract that can re-enter withdraw before the balance is fully drained.
The external ERC20 transfer can call back into sendReward during the payout.
A malicious token contract can re-enter sendRewards while it is still looping over winners.
